artifact_notice: Generated by a Reconstructed Baseline benchmark. This file does not represent historical production versions or historical production metrics.
status_explanation: The legacy Chroma default embedding and BGE Chinese embedding were compared on the same fixed RAG dataset.
methodology: The legacy per-sample baseline is reused from the previously executed rag_ablation.json. BGE uses an isolated temporary ChromaDB collection, the same 20 demonstration documents, and direct Top-5 retrieval without query rewrite or reranking. Recall and rank metrics are comparable; latency was not measured in the same run.
